[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taosym/dizzy-hearts-va-project?ref=cy3n9r][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32157465/4a91251535614cd9a022cc6a8fb9df6ad33ab437.png[/img][/url]

[b]Dizzy Hearts[/b] is a visual novel coming of age story where a girl from the sun-lit land of eternal day ventures into the moon-lit land of eternal night and elves. A yuri story, Dizzy Hearts is Steam safe but featuring ecchi/ero content and softcore nudity.

[i](unlike other titles we've released on steam, Dizzy Hearts is ecchi only, eroticism & mild nudity but not sex scenes.)[/i]

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taosym/dizzy-hearts-va-project?ref=cy3n9r]Dizzy Hearts VA Project on Kickstarter[/url][/b]

Dizzy Hearts is our very first conceptualized project, and started development a several years ago. We funded it through Kickstarter in fact, but ran into delays, however we've steadily built towards massively funding the project out of pocket and we're well on our way to completion!

This new Kickstarter is just for voice actors, we're teaming up with a pro recording studio Sound Cadence who've worked on some of your favorite anime! The cast they've assembled for us on this project speaks for itself I think, be sure to visit the Kickstarter page and check it out!
